title: Relay

settings.title: Relay
settings.description: Your assistant for requests, collections and environments.

enabled.label: Enable Relay
enabled.description: Show Relay entry points and the panel.

position.label: Default panel position
position.description: Which edge the Relay panel opens from.

shareValues.label: Share variable values with Relay
shareValues.description: Let Relay see the values of non-secret variables. Off by default.

clearHistory.label: Clear all Relay history
clearHistory.description: Delete every conversation and the changes recorded with it.
clearHistory.confirmDescription: Every conversation and its recorded changes will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
clearHistory.error: Couldn't clear Relay history. Try again.

explainer.title: What Relay can see
explainer.sees: The names of your requests, collections, environments and variables, plus the request or chain you have open.
explainer.hidden: Secret values are never shared. Other variable values stay hidden unless you turn on sharing above.
explainer.stored: Conversations are stored on this device. Your messages and the context above are sent to the Relay service to produce a reply.

dockLoadError: Relay couldn’t load. Check your connection and reload the page.
